fixtures.source: Locally synthesized speech, identical WAV input for all backends

limitations: Sequential single-machine run with one warmup and three English repeats; no shuffled order or accuracy corpus
Different production models/precision/decoding defaults; measures product configurations, not only implementation
No physical microphone or power/battery measurements

Whisper runs followed the Parakeet/MLX run; their sandbox permitted localhost worker IPC only. Turbo long-file timing was deliberately canceled after the completed short comparison; no timing is reported.
